content: स्ना €2 <ab>P.</ab> (स्नाति, स्नात) .²1 To bathe, perform ablution; सस्नुः पयः पपुरनेनिजुरम्बराणि <ls>Śi. 5. 28</ls>; मृगतृष्णाम्भसि स्नातः. .²2 To perform the ceremony of bathing at the time of leaving the house of oneʼs spiritual preceptor. .²3 To smear oneself with. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्नापयति-ते, स्नपयति-ते) .²1 To cause to bathe, wet, moisten, sprinkle; (तोयैः) सतूर्यमेनां स्नपयाम्बभूवुः <ls>Ku. 7. 10</ls>; स्मितस्नपिताधरा <ls>Gīt. 12</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 23</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 44</ls>, <ls n="Ki. 5.">47</ls>; <ls>Śi. 2. 7</ls>; <ls>Me. 45</ls>. .²2 To steep or soak in. .²3 To weep for. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (सिस्नासति) To wish to bathe. --{%With%} अप to bathe after mourning. -नि to plunge deep into; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} to be perfect or thoroughly versed in; see निष्णात; कुतोऽपत्यस्नेहः कुटिलनयनिष्णातमनसाम् <ls>Māl. 2. 7</ls>.
